row.question:
Based on Figure 1, which of the following findings most strongly supports the diagnosis of Swyer-James-MacLeod Syndrome in the patient?

A) Increased size of the right pulmonary hilum and symmetrical lung vasculature.
B) Decreased size of the right pulmonary hilum and asymmetry of the lung vasculature, with lower vascular markings on the right side.
C) Increased volume of the right lung with compensatory left lung volume reduction.
D) Normal pulmonary hilum size with equal vascular markings on both sides.
E) Increased vascular markings in the right lung with decreased size of the left pulmonary hilum.
F) Decreased size of the left pulmonary hilum and asymmetry of the lung vasculature, with lower vascular markings on the left side.

reference.correct_choice_text: Decreased size of the right pulmonary hilum and asymmetry of the lung vasculature, with lower vascular markings on the right side.

reflection_candidates.json.condition: When mediastinal opacity obscures one heart border and tracheal deviation is present on PA CXR
reflection_candidates.json.action: Inspect which cardiac border is silhouetted (left border loss = left mediastinal pathology; right border loss = right-sided) and confirm tracheal deviation direction—deviation away from mass side—and compare costophrenic angle blunting severity per side.
reflection_candidates.json.limitation: Unreliable if both borders obscured or in severe cardiomegaly; requires adequate inspiration and centering.

reflection_candidates.json.condition: When initial CXR shows lower lung opacity with diaphragmatic silhouetting and lateral confirmation of posterior basal location, and follow-up shows volume loss plus new apical lucency
reflection_candidates.json.action: Inspect for visceral pleural line at apex on PA view and check lateral for absence of lung markings beyond anterior chest wall; confirm no mediastinal shift
reflection_candidates.json.limitation: May miss small pneumothorax if overpenetrated or obscured by surgical hardware; requires comparison with prior films
